content.what_this_is: This letter gives your appointment for a blood test and diabetes review with Nurse Patel.
what_to_do: Do not eat for 10 hours before your blood test. You can drink plain water, but not tea, coffee or juice.
Take your usual medicines unless your doctor told you not to.
Bring a list of your medicines, your blood glucose meter and diary, and your urine sample pot.
Arrive 10 minutes early and check in at the front desk.
If you cannot come, call 01632 960 123 or cancel with the NHS App. If you feel very unwell, call 111.

by_when.what: Go to your appointment in Room 4, first floor, Riverside Health Centre

by_when.date: At least 24 hours before your appointment
by_when.what: Call or use the NHS App if you cannot come

safety_lines: In an emergency, call 999. For advice, call 111 or ask your pharmacist or GP.
